author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hello, fellow forum user! 

I feel as if the lobby needs some extra "spice" to it. I truly appreciate the addition of easter eggs and purchasable lobby items to make it more of a fun place, but I don't quite believe spending credits to get said items is worth the time you put into getting them. Thus, I suggest we get free, fun lobby features. 

  • Jumping stick- Yes, it's pretty self-explanatory. You just spawn with a stick in your hotbar, and when you right-click it, it sends you flying 20 blocks or so into the air. Of course, this could cause some cheating with the parkour, but since it's really just self-motivated, it won't be much of a problem. 
  • PVP arena- This is essentially 4-block-deep rectangular indent in the ground where you can jump in and punch people for fun. Your hearts would instantly be regenerated, so you can keep fighting as long as you'd want. This would lead to some enjoyment and potential warming up before playing on the server. 
  • Toggleable speed III- Nothing sophisticated; it's just meant for some fun chasing around the lobby for whatever reason may suit you. 

If you have any thoughts or ideas, please comment below! c:
